items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-04-04
items.q: Joe Howell learned me the best piece I ever played is Satanic Blues.

ctx.x: Even when they were faking that. Yeah.

Yeah, I made it a pad under there. Yeah. You should do it here. But Joe Howell learned me the best piece I ever played is Satanic Blues. You like that, huh? Yeah, I liked that finger in there, man. I used to kill them when they were one of the avatars with that thing, man.
Well let's have a little sample of that if you can do it
